entity.name: Doc's Seafood Shack & Oyster Bar
entity.address_line_1: 26029 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA
entity.editorial_summary: Longtime seafood destination dishing out classics such as oysters in bustling, no-frills surrounds.
entity.description: Doc's Seafood Shack is where Gulf Coast Alabama locals go for fresh seafood and Doc's famous fried shrimp. Since 1984 we have been grilling, frying and broiling seafood.
